name: Saint Dorei Onna Kyoushi
source:
Honnami Kyouhei is a pimp specializing in corrupting then whoring out housewives and members of the clergy. One day an unexpected offer reaches him: at the behest of the Nishiki/Seiki family, he is to infiltrate a school posing as a student, then through his evil means train the women within into lovely little whores. Kyouhei isn't into the idea: he doesn't like 'training' schoolgirls. But it turns out what his clients really want is for him to corrupt the teachers — who are preventing his employer from doing their own in work whoring out the student body.

After finding the weaknesses that he will use to cause each teacher's fall from virtue, Kyouhei takes the job and makes his way to the academy. A gleeful grin alights upon his face as he begins preparing to execute his plan, imagining the sordid figures his targets will make as he conquers their ripe, lascivious bodies...
translation:
本南恭平是一名皮条客，专门腐败并嫖娼家庭主妇和神职人员。有一天，他收到了一份意想不到的邀请：在锦/精木家族的要求下，他假扮成学生潜入一所学校，然后通过他的邪恶手段将学校里的女人训练成可爱的小妓女。Kyouhei不喜欢这个想法：他不喜欢“训练”女学生。但事实证明，他的客户真正想要的是他腐蚀老师——老师们正在阻止他的雇主自己做事，招揽学生。

在找到了导致每位老师失德的弱点后，恭平接受了这份工作并前往学院。当他开始准备执行他的计划时，他的脸上露出了愉快的笑容，想象着他的目标在征服他们成熟、淫荡的身体时会做出什么样的肮脏形象……
